shots.text: 后续用药、护理和复查，都需要按医嘱安排，做好治疗前后的配合。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.

shots.text: 治疗前摘掉隐形眼镜，按要求清除眼妆。近期眼部手术、感染，都要如实告知。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.
shots.keypoint: 摘镜清妆，如实告知病史

shots.text: 眼部外伤，以及正在使用的药物，也要完整、准确地告诉医生。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.

shots.text: 如果有明显红痛、分泌物增多，或眼周皮肤破损，请先告诉医生。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.

shots.text: 是否需要延期，要先由医生评估。不要为了赶进度，把这些情况隐瞒下来。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.

shots.text: 睑板腺按摩不是越痛越有效，明显疼痛要及时说，向医护人员反馈。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.

shots.text: 回家别模仿器械操作，也不要用力挤眼皮。后续护理仍要按医嘱安排。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.

shots.text: 如果用了表面麻醉，感觉恢复前别揉眼，回家也不要自行模仿器械操作。
shots.action: The doctor speaks to the viewer with natural lip and jaw articulation, blinking and gentle breathing. Her hands remain relaxed at her sides. The anatomical eye model and small bottles remain in their supplied positions.
